note: FDXR mutations characteristically present as auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder and optic atrophy (sensorial neuropathy) rather than early fatal neonatal metabolic collapse typical of MMDS1-3.

evidence.text: Biallelic FDXR mutations cause sensorial neuropathy presenting with auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy, demonstrating a distinct sensory neuropathy phenotype within mitochondrial Fe-S synthesis disorders.

source.title: FDXR mutations cause sensorial neuropathies and expand the spectrum of mitochondrial Fe-S-synthesis diseases
source.quote: Here, we report on eight subjects from four independent families affected by auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy. Whole-exome sequencing revealed biallelic mutations in FDXR in affected subjects of each family.

numbers.metric: affected subjects with auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy

evidence.text: A literature review of 46 individuals with biallelic FDXR variants found that auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy are the predominant clinical hallmarks.

source.title: Biallelic FDXR mutations induce ferroptosis in a rare mitochondrial disease with ataxia
source.quote: clinical phenotypes of the 46 reported patients with FDXR variants [2,3,[32], [33], [34], [35], [36], [37]]. The most prevalent clinical features included auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy
